messages:
Devon (PM): Beta feedback: side-by-side regression view has discoverability + a11y issues. Users confused by 'pin baseline', legend colors low contrast, keyboard nav is inconsistent. Can we propose fixes?

Priya (Design): Suggested tweaks: rename 'Pin baseline' -> 'Lock left column', add icon+label to legend, show high-contrast focus outline on tiles. I'll mock a compact legend with icons.

Malik (Frontend): Keyboard plan: implement roving tabindex across tiles; left/right to switch panes, up/down within pane. Add shortcut 'L' to toggle Lock-left. Will add integration test for focus order.

Lena (A11y): For SRs: each tile should announce "Tile X of Y. Baseline vA vs Candidate vB. Severity: moderate." Use role="button" and aria-pressed for lock state. Make legend tooltips keyboard-openable.

Theo (Data UX): Add numeric ranges to legend tooltips (e.g., minor 0.1-0.3). Make ranges editable in Run settings per project. I'll draft schema.

Priya (Design): Copy proposals: Lock tooltip: "Lock left column: keep baseline fixed while paging candidates. Shortcut: L." Legend label: "Change severity (higher = bigger difference)".

Devon (PM): Prioritize: 1) keyboard + aria, 2) rename + shortcut, 3) legend icons + numeric hover. Then iterate on connector/pinned comments.

Malik (Frontend): Note: connector lines for pinned comments will be SVG overlay; set aria-hidden and provide SR description on the candidate tile.

Lena (A11y): Ensure color choices meet 4.5:1 contrast or provide icon alternatives. Also allow users to disable verbose SR announcements in Settings.

ci-bot: PR checklist: keyboard tests, aria attributes, legend icons present. All green required to merge.

Devon (PM): Action items: Priya update mocks, Malik implement, Lena review, Theo spec ranges. Ship keyboard+copy changes in micro-release. Thanks!"
